QUOTE: "the weak-to-strong transfer accuracy was 0.87" METRIC: transfer_acc ISSUE: transfer_acc is 0.78; 0.87 is the strong ceiling.
QUOTE: "the margin between the two exceeds twice the reported standard error, so the method outperforms the baseline under this comparison" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: the 0.31 gap is ~3.1x SE but with only 6 seeds and no baseline SE this significance claim is overstated.
